title: Hand in Hand
lyrics: [Verse]
Two little kids in the big green wood,
Hansel and Gretel did the best they could,
Hansel dropped pebbles, shiny and white,
They found their way home in the moonlight
[Chorus]
Hand in hand, hand in hand,
Hungry and small, but a brave little band,
A friend by your side makes the dark seem light,
Together we're strong, and it all turns out right
[Verse]
Next time he dropped some bread on the ground,
Little birds ate every crumb they found,
Then a gingerbread house came into sight,
With candy and cookies, oh what a delight!
[Chorus]
Hand in hand, hand in hand,
Hungry and small, but a brave little band,
A friend by your side makes the dark seem light,
Together we're strong, and it all turns out right
[Bridge]
A grumpy old witch lived in the sweet little home,
She locked up Hansel, and he felt alone,
But Gretel stayed calm and thought it through,
And her clever plan came true
[Verse]
The witch's spell was gone that day,
They gathered treasure and went on their way,
Home to Father, hugs so tight,
No more hungry, all was right
[Chorus]
Hand in hand, hand in hand,
Home again, a happy little band,
A friend by your side makes the dark seem light,
Together we're strong, and it all turns out right
[Outro]
Hand in hand, safe and sound,
Home again, where love is found

source.author: Brothers Grimm
source.public_domain_basis: Published before 1931; both authors died over 150 years ago
